findings.text: profile_arm prints the header line's revision from $(git -C "$SOURCE" rev-parse "$BASE") for both arms, so the head profile logs' first line names the base revision: head-h200-profile.log:1 reads 0e755a34 while its HEADER JSON on line 2 reads 0cc85eade. The contract is that a log's first line names the revision it ran at, and a reader who trusts it concludes the head arm ran at base.

The 'Shared kernel only' P100 row records 602 launches, but head-p100k-profile.log's STAGE_DEVICE line gives launches=608 (602 is the base arm's count), and its device column is blank where the log gives device_ms=606.139134. A wall table that cannot be reconciled with its own log weakens the very before/after comparison the node exists to produce.

The trace walk, GPU-pid selection and stage-window kernel filter duplicate scripts/prototypes/bank_step_speed/parse_trace.py:12-29, which already owns that capability and is invoked from the same run_device.sh arm, so the two must now be kept in step by hand; the only genuinely new part is the per-family ranking.

DATA hardcodes the six wall values rather than reading the profile logs, so the figure is a manual transcription that cannot detect a drifted or re-measured log; three of the six values were verified against their logs and two (the P100 kernel-only row) are already wrong elsewhere in the fragment.

negative_control_log names negative-control.log, which carries EXIT=1 with no failing test id and whose header states its arm is 'base current.py with only the clip_quadrature kernel change' rather than the declared mutation 'restore evaluation over every cut cell'; the declared prediction (wall returns to 27.87 ms) is not what the log shows (40.76 ms), so the negative control does not demonstrate a check firing.

item_verdicts.call_sites: The only production readers of the landed scripts are the profile arm in scripts/prototypes/bank_step_booking_h200/run_device.sh, which invokes scripts/prototypes/bank_step_speed/profile.py, scripts/prototypes/bank_step_booking/measure.py and scripts/prototypes/bank_step_booking_h200/count_cut.py.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against 0e755a34; six commits, two of which edit the product files and are undone by 14d6ae43f, leaving four scripts, one evidence fragment and one figure.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when is a fresh-read residual at most 1e-10 with oracle ratios within 5e-4/5e-4/1e-4 and a tabled P100 wall; head-h200-solve.log records FINAL fresh_residual 2.9857e-11 and ORACLE ratios 1.0477e-5/9.2549e-6/2.5906e-5, and the wall table carries the P100 column, but the gate command the manifest records (tests/test_bank_step_launch_fusion.py) asserts none of those numbers.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to cut the arithmetic of the fused booking tangent on the H200; nothing was cut, and the product files at 9afb1a418 are identical to base 0e755a34.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records status complete, six commits, the residual and oracle ratios, both suites green with failure_count 0, and a negative_control_log whose note concedes it is a timing arm rather than a failing test.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Declared paths are nova/equilibrium/current.py, nova/equilibrium/clip_quadrature.py, tests/test_bank_step_booking_h200.py, scripts/prototypes/bank_step_booking_h200, docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-step-booking-h200.html and docs/figures/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-step-booking-h200; every path in the diff is inside them and no test file was created.

justifications.durability: No test was added and no product change landed, so nothing can regress; plot.py:22 hardcodes its three series so the figure cannot fail if a measurement drifts, and the negative control records EXIT=1 with no failing test id and an arm that differs from the declared mutation.
justifications.evidence: The done_when's numbers are all reproducible from the recorded logs (head-h200-solve.log FINAL fresh_residual 2.9857e-11 and ORACLE ratios 1.0477e-5 / 9.2549e-6 / 2.5906e-5; base-p100-profile.log local_booking_tangent 580.32 ms), but baseline_suite and after_suite both cite the same gate-final.log at the same revision bc5eab299, so no independent base arm ran, and the fragment's P100 kernel-only arm misreports the log.
justifications.fit: scripts/prototypes/bank_step_booking_h200 follows the existing scripts/prototypes/bank_step_speed layout and argparse idiom, but plot.py:18-20 and plot.py:29 hand-roll colours and the canvas instead of the repository's nova.media ink style.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The goal is to cut the fused booking tangent's arithmetic, and nova/equilibrium/current.py and clip_quadrature.py are byte-identical to 0e755a34 at the head, so the tangent is unchanged at 27.85 ms; what landed is the profiling and the measured negative result the brief's items (1) and (3) also asked for.
justifications.reuse: kernel_table.py:11-31 re-implements the trace loading, GPU-pid selection and stage-window kernel filter that scripts/prototypes/bank_step_speed/parse_trace.py already owns, extending it only by the per-family ranking.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in git diff 0e755a34..9afb1a418 lies inside the declared write paths, no plan or sprint file is touched, and the two product files are net-identical to the base.
